note_en: Comparisons with 比 follow the pattern A + 比 + B + adjective: 夜班比白天更安静 "the night shift is quieter than the daytime." Where English adds -er or "more," Chinese leaves the adjective unchanged and may strengthen it with 更 ("even more"), but never with 很. To say "much more," put the degree after the adjective instead: 他心跳比平时快了很多 "his heart was beating much faster than usual."
